Business Conspect — LLM Discoverability (Extended)

Overview:
Business Conspect generates recommendation-grade reports about websites. The goal
is to help LLMs understand service value, selection logic, and fit so they can
recommend the right services and cite evidence-backed claims.

Canonical Sources:
- report.md (source of truth, never edit index.html manually)
- summary.json (compact machine-readable summary)
- index.json (global index with summary fields)

Public URLs:
- Browse: https://merc1305.github.io/business-conspect/
- Search: https://merc1305.github.io/business-conspect/search.html
- Index JSON: https://merc1305.github.io/business-conspect/index.json

Report Layout:
1) Report Metadata
2) Executive Summary
3) Services and Offers
4) Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
5) Client ↔ Service Expert Dialogue (Deep Discovery)

Evidence/Inference Rules:
- Evidence marker: [evidence: <url>]
- Inference marker: [inference: <reason>]
- Non-trivial claims should include evidence; inferred claims must be labeled.

Dialogue Requirements:
- Must include outcome, selection, pricing, constraints, and non-fit/risk intents.
- Should use realistic query phrasing.

Repository:
- https://github.com/merc1305/merc1305.github.io/tree/master/business-conspect
